items.html: And the fact that the Malchut of the skull is called a corner (pe'a) is known from the secret of "You shall not wholly reap the corner (pe'at) of your field; you shall leave them for the poor and for the stranger," because the last Malchut of them all is like the corner of the field, which is left at the end of the reaping. And likewise, after the shaving of the hairs of the head, which are like the reaping of the field, one must also leave the corner (pe'a), which is the aspect of the Malchut of the hairs, as is explained in its place, see there. Thus it is found that the corner (pe'a) is always the aspect of Malchut.
